name: Seraphina
source:
A kind, compassionate young woman who is struggling to find a place for herself in the world. Although she starts off soft-spoken and a little shy in her brand new home, she can be very headstrong and is actually quite passionate.

Fun fact: she dreams of being a painter!

[From [url=https://www.gretuskigames.com/peachleaf-valley/]official website[/url]]
